answer: Put Endorsed mail sorter service record with postal workers confirmation at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 379 aliases would need 379 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The summit sits in the mechanism itself, the plume sits in the price of faking it, and the opal sits in the record no template can forge. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
